items.title: Reynolds
items.author: John’s Gospel as “Apocalyptic” Gospel - Benjamin E
items.why: This chapter discusses the Gospel of John in the context of its apocalyptic themes, which includes the fulfillment of Old Testament prophecies and the implications of Jesus' rejection by Israel. It also addresses the resurrection as a pivotal moment in Jesus' mission, aligning well with the claims regarding the Upper Room Discourse and the transition to a Spirit-mediated presence.
